exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus A1 (GDM A1) status
outcome: Insulin resistance levels (METS-IR and TyG index values) during early, mid, and late pregnancy
cohort: 344 pregnant women, classified as having Gestational Diabetes Mellitus A1 (n=118) or being healthy, based on a 75-g oral glucose tolerance test conducted at 24-28 weeks of gestation.
finding: Women with GDM A1 exhibited higher insulin resistance throughout pregnancy compared to healthy controls, but early-pregnancy METS-IR and TyG indices were not associated with delivery characteristics or fetal parameters, and METS-IR may not be a reliable surrogate due to BMI changes.
mod_finding: Early-pregnancy METS-IR and TyG values were not significantly associated with mode of delivery.
